notes.title: Fifth Dimension
notes.content:
The following bugs have been fixed:
[olist]
 Dimension 1.


 After exiting the first house of the first biome in the first dimension, the game experienced some lag, but now everything works correctly.
 After leaving houses in the first dimension, an orange bar appeared for a second, covering half the screen. This has been fixed. Screen fading after entering and exiting buildings now looks smooth and pleasant.

 Dimension 2.

 In the second dimension, on the 14th level, a new platform was added to make it easier to access the trampoline.
 On the 16th level of the second dimension, visuals have been adjusted to make solving the puzzle more obvious.
 On the 17th level, it was unclear which buttons were pressed and which were not. Now everything works correctly.

 Dimension 4.

 After starting a new game, the palette in the fourth dimension did not appear in its correct place, and the "paint" option in the main menu remained active. Now everything works correctly.
 After exiting to the menu in the middle of the dimension and returning back, everything broke. Now everything works correctly.

[/olist]
New content added:

 Dimension 5 has been added.

Localization errors fixed:

 In the third dimension, regardless of the selected language, the task was displayed only in Ukrainian. Now the task is displayed in all available languages.

Visual changes have been made.

Thank you for playing, dragons!

notes.title: Fourth dimension
notes.content:
The following bugs have been fixed:

 In the third dimension, navigation in the dialogue with the Tesseract was incorrect when using the mouse. Now, everything works correctly.
 Fragments of the page in the album from the third dimension were all visible at once. Now, each fragment becomes visible as a separate memory is found.

New content added:

 Added Dimension #4.
 Added a new album page.
 Added a drawing tool in the main menu so players can express their creative side.

Some visual changes have been made.

Thank you for playing, dragons!

notes.title: 30 June 2024 Update
notes.content:
The following bugs have been fixed:


 The memory in the first house of the first biome in the first dimension was not moving and was black instead of blue. Now, it is as it should be.
 When dying on the saws in the third house of the first biome in the first dimension, the player would end up in the same house. Now, they will start at the beginning of the biome.
 After the player passed ALL the portals in the third biome of the first dimension, they would activate FOREVER. This was intended, but a recent update broke this mechanic. Now, everything works correctly.
 Memories from the fourth dimension were displayed incorrectly in the album. Now, everything displays correctly.
 The achievement for collecting all memories in the fourth dimension was not triggering. Now, if you find all the memories and visit the corresponding album page, you will receive the achievement.
 In the first dimension, when the skeleton exited any building, a line and some graphical elements appeared on the screen for a second after the fade-out. We've removed this. (We thought we did it last time, but now FOR SURE) Now, the transition between locations looks smoother and softer.

Thank you for playing, dragons!

notes.title: 5 June 2024 Update
notes.content:
Read the update details below. First, I want to remind you that the war in Ukraine is still ongoing. Due to ruzzia's terrorist actions, specifically their destruction of our country's energy system, my home had electricity for only 4 hours yesterday. This situation is the same across Ukraine. Therefore, support Ukraine. We are not asking you to save us. We are asking you to help us save ourselves and, in the long run, your safety too. Help with your voice if you have one, with your money if you have it, and with your heart. Now, regarding the game. 

The following bugs have been fixed:

 In the third biome of the first dimension, there was occasional image stuttering during teleportation. This has now been fixed.
 In the first dimension, when the skeleton exited any building, a line and some graphical elements would appear on the screen for a second after the blackout. We have removed this. The transition between locations now looks smoother and more seamless.

Some visual changes have been made.

Thank you for playing, dragons!

notes.title: Third Dimension
notes.content:
Tesseract once again sends our little skeleton to another dimension, one related to creativity. Or not?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831618/3d27e6bb8b585cf00038f536aa2111d28e51f04b.png

The following bugs have been fixed:

 The achievement for collecting all memories in the second biome did not activate. Now, for players who haven't received it yet, it will activate correctly, and those who haven't received it despite collecting all memories will receive it after entering the "Album" section.
 Fixed a bug that caused no delay in player movement at the beginning of the scene of the last building in the first biome.
 Fixed a bug where the skeleton moved too fast for the first second upon appearing in the biome scene.

New content added:

 New dimension.
 New album page.

Localization errors fixed:

 On the sixth level of the second dimension, the task was displayed only in Ukrainian. Now it is displayed in all declared languages.
 In several languages, the names of the biomes in the first dimension were displayed incorrectly. Now they are displayed correctly.

Some visual changes have been made.

Thank you for playing, dragons!

notes.title: 5 February 2024 Update
notes.content:
The following bugs have been fixed:

 Camera "shaking" in biomes has been eliminated.
 Sometimes the sound of the "chasing" ghost was interrupted halfway. Now it doesn't interrupt.


Localization:

 Added a Tesseract's line explaining that in case of difficulties, players should find him in the biome where the difficulties arose and ask him a corresponding question.


Miscellaneous:

 Nowhere was it explained that to get hints on what to do next, players should consult the Tesseract. Therefore, a question mark has been added above the building with the Tesseract on the map of the 4th biome, and the Tesseract now has a line explaining that in case of difficulties, players should find him in the biome where the difficulties arose and ask him a corresponding question.
 In the main menu, the button to go to the email has been changed to a button to go to our Telegram channel.
 Our email has been added to the "People" section in the main menu.


Thank you for being with us, dragons!

notes.title: 2 February 2024 Update (p.2)
notes.content:
The following bugs have been fixed:


 - Sometimes, all memories were displayed in the memories room regardless of whether they had been collected. Now everything works correctly.

notes.title: 2 February 2024 Update
notes.content:
The following bugs have been fixed:


 - The gate image between the 3rd and 4th biomes no longer overlaps the map image when it becomes active.


 - The logic for reading mouse cursor items in the memories room has been changed. Now tooltips appear correctly.


 - In the memories room, an invisible area around the main character interfered with cursor item detection. Now this process works correctly.


 - The dialogue box area interfered with cursor item detection. This area now ignores the mouse cursor and does not affect its operation.


 - The enemy animation in the first biome was "jerky"; the animation, playback time, and type of reproduction have been fixed. Now the animation is smooth and not "jerky."


Localization errors have been fixed:


 - Several expressions in German have been corrected.


Some visual changes have been made.

Thank you for playing, dragons!
